case_title: Synthetic competitor comparison and wedge review
operator_notes: Fictional synthetic review case for deterministic Phase 2 behavior.
target_market: Traveling pet owners in mixed-density urban areas
user_problem: They need a trustworthy local provider rapidly when plans change.
proposed_minimum_useful_pilot: One curated contact page per neighborhood with verified response windows.
reasons_not_to_pursue: Operator participation might be too low initially

competitors.name: Spruce Local
competitors.operator_notes: Strong profile density in two neighborhoods.

competitors.name: Lantern Listings
competitors.operator_notes: Content-rich pages with limited operator metadata.

competitors.name: Harbor Directory
competitors.operator_notes: Simple directory structure with sparse workflow detail.

evidence.statement: Spruce Local shows a visible last-updated timestamp on most operator cards.
evidence.operator_notes: Observed directly in synthetic artifact set.

evidence.statement: Lantern Listings does not display verification indicators on listing cards.
Harbor Directory includes paid-featured rows on only selected categories.
Visible freshness cues may reduce operator-trust friction for first contact.
Operators may pay for manual verification if lead quality appears higher.
The best initial neighborhood mix is not yet known.

unresolved_questions: Which outreach script produces the best operator response rate?
operator_recommendation_rationale: Continue manual evidence collection before deciding GO or REJECT.

research_questions.question_text: Do any competitors expose update freshness reliably?
research_questions.operator_notes: Answer is based on supplied synthetic artifacts only.

research_questions.question_text: How clearly do competitors expose monetization pathways?
Which workflow reduces urgent contact friction the most?

comparison_dimensions.label: Freshness
comparison_dimensions.description: How clearly recency is represented in listing data.
comparison_dimensions.why_it_matters: Users and operators infer reliability from recency cues.

comparison_dimensions.label: Structured detail
comparison_dimensions.description: How much structured metadata appears for each listing.
comparison_dimensions.why_it_matters: Structured detail speeds filtering and outreach decisions.

comparison_dimensions.label: Verification
comparison_dimensions.description: Whether trust indicators are shown on listing surfaces.
comparison_dimensions.why_it_matters: Trust markers can reduce first-contact hesitation.

comparison_dimensions.label: User workflow
comparison_dimensions.description: How direct the path is from discovery to contact.
comparison_dimensions.why_it_matters: Fewer workflow steps can reduce abandonment.

comparison_observations.statement: Spruce Local visibly presents update recency on most cards.
Lantern Listings shows no verification indicator in card UI.
Harbor Directory includes structured fields for only some categories.
The full contact workflow path was not captured in supplied artifacts.
No direct booking workflow is present in this competitor model.

wedge_candidates.title: Manual verification timestamp overlay
wedge_candidates.user_pain: Hard to trust listing accuracy during urgent planning.
wedge_candidates.proposed_advantage: Verified timestamp and response-window annotation on each listing.
wedge_candidates.competitor_gap: Existing competitors do not consistently expose verification freshness.
reasons_the_wedge_might_fail: Verification workflow could be too labor-intensive
Operators may not value timestamp badges
wedge_candidates.smallest_manual_test: Manually verify and annotate 12 listings across two neighborhoods.
wedge_candidates.success_signal: At least 4 operators request continuation after review.
wedge_candidates.invalidating_signal: No operator asks for repeated inclusion after first pass.
wedge_candidates.next_operator_action: Build operator shortlist and run first verification cycle.
wedge_candidates.operator_notes: Ready for a limited manual pilot only.

wedge_candidates.title: Urgent booking handoff board
wedge_candidates.operator_notes: Intentionally incomplete for structural readiness demonstration.
